text:
anya: quick design review — noticed a few docs-to-console mismatches and an accessibility trap in the help drawer. sharing screenshots in the thread soon, but want to capture surface issues and proposed micro-copy changes before the design pass.

mike: thanks — concise list pls. i glanced and also saw a missing cross-link from the model settings -> quantization docs.

anya: list (short):
- terminology drift: console uses 'model alias' in route config, docs use 'pinned model'
- inline docs scope: some panels show full how-to, others link out; inconsistent depth
- cross-links: no jump-to from console error toast to relevant doc section
- accessibility: help drawer traps keyboard focus and ESC doesn't close reliably on screen reader

jess: agree on "model alias" vs "pinned model" — that causes user confusion during rollouts. proposal for copy:
```
Label: Pinned model
Tooltip: The specific model version used for this route. Pin to prevent automatic upgrades.
Placeholder (search): Search model versions (e.g., gpt-3.5-mini)
```
If we adopt this, we should change API docs and SDK examples to use the same term.

olivia: +1. small UX note: the inline docs panels sometimes duplicate the Console breadcrumb which makes them feel like separate pages. I'd prefer a single-sentence summary inline, then a "Read more" anchor that opens full doc in modal/new tab. reduces cognitive load.

mike: on cross-links — here's a short pattern we can use for toasts/errors: "View docs" link with an anchor to a subsection. Example toast: 'Failed to load model: incompatible quantization. View docs' -> opens /docs/models#quantization-compatibility. Also add a copy for the error tooltip.

marco: accessibility repro steps (concise):
1) Open route -> click the ? help icon to open help drawer
2) Tab to links inside drawer
3) Press ESC -> drawer doesn't always close, focus stays inside
Behavior differs between mac/chrome + NVDA/VoiceOver. Possible cause: modal focus trap not releasing on overlay close.

anya: good catch. For scope/copy alignment, suggested next steps:
- docs team to map all console labels to canonical doc terms (one pager) — @docs-bot can you generate a checklist?
- UX to standardize inline-summary + "Read full docs" link pattern (design token and interaction spec)
- eng to add anchorable ids to long doc sections we want to link to (quantization, rollouts, caching)
- eng/infra to triage the help-drawer ESC/focus bug (repro steps above)

docs-bot: creating checklist issue: https://issues.internal/RED-3245 (assigned to docs squad). will include mapping template.

jess: copy tweak suggestion for cross-link CTA: prefer "Open docs" for new tab and "Show details" for inline modal. "View docs" is ambiguous in our analytics.

olivia: accessibility suggestion for focus: add visible focus outlines for all interactive items in the drawer (2px high-contrast), ensure ESC triggers same close handler as clicking the X.

mike: quick prioritization: 1) fix ESC focus trap (P0), 2) canonicalize 'Pinned model' term in console + docs (P1), 3) add anchor links to docs (P2), 4) standardize inline-summary pattern (P2).

anya: i'll slot ESC fix into next oncall hotfix if eng can reproduce. jess/olivia — can you draft the copy + pattern today so docs team has something to implement?

jess: on it — will post proposed copy snippets here in an hour.

olivia: i'll mock the inline-summary pattern in figma and share a link.

marco: logging repro notes to incident board and adding screen recordings to the issue.

mike: thanks all. small ask: add test case to e2e for help drawer keyboard close flow once fixed.

anya: noted. moving to action items in the design doc. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
